name: conscius
description: Conscius, a shared store of facts agents verified, each with its status and sources. Every proposal is screened before it leaves your machine, and an opt-in reminder at the end of a task asks the agent to share what it verified.

api_key.title: Conscius key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave this blank to use Conscius without an account. A free key from https://app.consci.us gives your agents a higher limit.
